when.user_text: Chart the kayak hires at the boathouse for the season.
Draw how a kayak hire goes, from arriving to handing the paddle back.

blocks.text:
A hire goes like this:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Arrive at the boathouse] --> B{Booked ahead?}
  B -->|Yes| C[Sign the sheet]
  B -->|No| D[Wait for a free kayak]
  D --> C
  C --> E[Fitted with a life jacket]
  E --> F([On the water])
  F --> G[Back by five]
  G --> H[Rinse the kayak and hand in the paddle]
```

The only branch is whether the visitor booked ahead.

A sequence diagram:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant V as Visitor
  participant D as Desk
  participant S as Slipway
  V->>D: Asks for a double kayak
  D->>S: Is one free?
  S-->>D: Two are back
  D-->>V: Sign here, and a jacket each
  V->>S: Launches
  S-->>D: Back and rinsed by five
```
